tagkin

Tagkin · design hand-off v1 · 11 Nov 2026

Protect what you value.

QR tags for bags, keys, gear and pets. Finders report without an app; owners manage tags in the app. Private by default, in many languages.

Finder (web)

Welcome→Private by default→Terms→Sign in→Email code→Notifications→Add your first tag

Create a tag→Type→Details (item, travel, pet)→Finder message→Style→Tag is live→Order or gift

Activate it→Camera→Scan or code→New tag found→Type, details, message→Tag is live→Activate another
Order
For me / Gift a tag→Product and quantity→Delivery details→Review and pay→Order placed

Mark as lost→Scan alerts→Finder report→Messages→Mark returned
Manage
My tags→Tag detail→Edit message, contacts→QR and test scan→Retire
Account
Plan→Notifications→Language→Appearance→Privacy and data→Delete account

Tag states: Unclaimed → Normal ⇄ Lost → Return active → Normal · any state → Retired (permanent).

Finder flow

No app, no sign-up. Tested with 5 people, no concerns.

First launch, activation and account

Welcome, terms, permission explainers, linking a printed tag, data and account deletion.

Owner registration and ordering

Email code sign-in, five steps to a live tag, then order it printed.

Gift a tag

Order printed tags for someone else. They activate and personalise them.

Lost mode and messages

Urgent finder page, scan alerts, relayed messages.

Travel, Pet, safety and settings

Tag-type details, report and block, plan, notifications, language, splash and app icon.

States and tag management

Empty and error states, locked fields during a return, editing, history and retiring.

Component states and loading

Every interactive component in each state, and loading screens.

Permissions turned off, and languages

Recovery when someone taps “Don’t allow”, a long-text check in German, and a right-to-left check in Arabic.

Emails and push notifications

The message relay in words. Emails go from hello@tagkin.app; replies are relayed, never forwarded with addresses.

Finder on a computer

Same steps as the phone, centred in a card. People often type tagkin.app on a laptop.

tagkin.app website

Home, privacy and support. Apple and Google require privacy and support links before approval.

App Store and Google Play screenshots

Concept set, 1290 × 2796 (shown at 300 × 650). The background pattern runs across panels like one strip. Re-shoot with the real app before submitting.

Printed tags

Print artwork for the print partner. Dashed line = trim, outer area = 3 mm bleed. The QR stays black on white with a quiet zone of 4 modules, whatever the style.

Downloads and lock screen

What “Save to phone lock screen” and “Print at home (free tag)” produce. Only the free tag can be downloaded.

Accessibility rules

Built in from the first line of code. Checked again before launch.

ContrastAll text and icons meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text and controls), light and dark.
Touch targetsAt least 44 × 44 pt (iOS) and 48 × 48 dp (Android). Primary buttons are 52 high.
Text sizeSupports Dynamic Type and Android font scaling up to 200%. Layouts reflow; nothing is cut off.
Screen readersEvery control has a label (“Show QR code for Black backpack”). Status badges are read as words, not colours.
Focus orderTop to bottom, header first, primary action last. Sheets and dialogs trap focus until closed.
Colour is never the only signalLost uses red plus the word Lost and an icon. Errors have text, not just a red border.
MotionRespects Reduce Motion: no parallax, spinners become static, transitions shorten.
LanguageRight-to-left layouts mirror. Long German words wrap. Translated text is marked with its language for screen readers.
